text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 256 tablets of valacyclovir hydrochloride 1 g with a daily use of 15.6, giving 16.4 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show valacyclovir hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current supply covers about 16 days. The ranked first alternate manufacturer, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, is not on FDA's shortage list today. AvPAK, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Chartwell RX, LLC, and Direct _Rx are also not on the shortage list, but their labels name no plant we could place. Our current label names Northwind Health Company, LLC (FEI 1831143) as a repack plant with a VAI inspection on 2025-09-26.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer: Verify the Northwind Health Company, LLC repack plant (FEI 1831143) remains suitable for use.
2. Buyer: Confirm product availability from Aurobindo Pharma Limited's plants (APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, Aurolife Pharma LLC) before purchasing.
3. P&T Committee: Approve Aurobindo Pharma Limited as the preferred alternate source if availability and plant suitability are confirmed.
4. Buyer: If Aurobindo supply is unavailable, evaluate AvPAK, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Chartwell RX, LLC, and Direct _Rx only after obtaining verifiable plant information for each.

Not recommended: Purchasing from any alternate manufacturer without confirming plant identity and inspection status.
